name: Futuristic Gallery
description: Circular WebGL image viewer where a pixelated wave dissolve transitions between photos, switched with chamfered thumbnail buttons in the corner.
contents: Circular framed WebGL canvas showing the active image
Row of chamfered thumbnail buttons with titles as labels
behavior: Clicking a thumbnail runs a pixelate and wave dissolve shader transition to that image
Clicks are ignored while a transition is running
Active thumbnail is highlighted with the accent color, others dim until hovered
Canvas shrinks to 90vw on narrow screens
editableByProps: Main images, thumbnails and their titles
Background, frame, border, gradient, transition fill and accent colors
Canvas size, transition speed and pixel grid resolution

needsCodeEdit.change: Move or restyle the thumbnail row
needsCodeEdit.where: thumbnailImages.map block at the bottom of the component

fixed: Fills the full viewport height with an absolutely centered circle and thumbnails pinned bottom right
mainImages and thumbnailImages must have the same length and order
Needs images that allow cross-origin texture loading
